desc:
Welcome to Cheapest Slap Tower 🏢💸 — the broken, scuffed, and budget-built slap adventure you never asked for but definitely needed.
Climb a tower filled with cheap traps, random knockback gadgets, questionable engineering, and players who will do ANYTHING to slap you off the map 👋🤣.

Every floor gets harder, crazier, and more unpredictable 😭🔥.
Use wacky slap tools, dodge chaotic obstacles, launch your friends into space 🌌💥, and try — just try — to reach the top without losing your mind 😵‍💫.

Are you skilled enough… or just lucky enough… to survive the CHEAPEST tower ever built? 🏆👀
Jump in and find out.
